{{Quote|I saw full-left-handed what this Grand Admiral Thrawn did to my world's defenses ten standardcycles ago.|A Sronk Senator|<ref name="SotP" />}}
'''Sronk''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and the [[Sronk]] species [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==History==
During the [[Thrawn campaign]], Sronk's defenses were [[Battle of unidentified world|beaten]] by seven [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]]. When [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] appeared to return in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Sronk [[Senator/Legends|senator]], who had personally witnessed his homeworld's defeat, advised caution to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="SotP" />
